scope: 384 frozen DEV questions, 128 per task, no labels or scoring during generation

selection.policy: every frozen DEV question, original input order

endpoint_policy: Generate E2/000 and E2/111 anew for each question; E1 endpoints are comparisons, not substituted predictions. E3 uses these same-run endpoints by question and immutable generation-record hash.
tensor_retention: fixed three DEV anchors (one per task): full original visual/DS, selected-before and actual-injected three-slot arrays; remaining questions: only per-slot/feature summaries, selection, positions, output and runtime intervention/injection checks; non-anchor tensors cannot be reconstructed offline
scoring: Each family remains locked until its entire 384-question inventory has passed formal and independent no-GT acceptance and actual exit checks.
guard: No GPU execution until completed E4-B identity and actual E2/E3 smoke acceptance/review, frozen independent code review, actual same-container full preflight, bounded supervisor and exclusive GPU.
diagnostic_anchor_policy: Use the same three preselected and independently accepted E2/E3 smoke questions, one per task; freeze identities before full panel and do not select by predictions.
